assertion.rationale: F9 (Task 13): resource-plane actions are traceable. The subscription Activity Log (layer-06-platform.yml) captures the caller identity behind every ARM create/update/delete in the estate (Administrative category); Key Vault diagnosticSettings captures AuditEvent (who read/wrote which secret, key, certificate); SQL auditSettings with isAzureMonitorTargetEnabled:true captures per-principal database activity; storage and CAE diagnosticSettings cover the rest of the Azure resource plane -- all landing in the same Log Analytics workspace platform/main.bicep wires. The directory/identity plane is now traceable too: layer-06-platform.yml also routes Entra ID SignInLogs and AuditLogs to the same workspace (az monitor diagnostic-settings create --resource "/providers/microsoft.aadiam"), so which human or workload identity authenticated, which Conditional Access policy evaluated, and which directory role assignment changed are captured alongside the resource-plane events. A first pass deferred this item as unverifiable without a live tenant; review corrected that -- the resource shape and the required Security Administrator Entra role are both publicly documented (Microsoft Learn), not tenant-dependent unknowns. One recorded, separate loose end (not a reason this control reopens, same treatment F20/F21 got under F13): nothing in this repo's IaC grants mls-github-deployer the Security Administrator role the Entra step needs at runtime, so whether it succeeds live is unverified -- recorded in that step's own comment. A prior pass also downgraded this control's gapSeverity from high to medium for partial progress; reverted on review per 3.1.5.json's precedent (F13 five-of-seven landed, severity held at high -- severity is a property of the finding, not a progress meter). With the Entra routing now also implemented, F9 has no remaining open contributor, so this control closes outright. Checked: no other finding in compliance/findings/2026-08-26-prepublication-review.md cites 3.3.2.

recommendation: None outstanding for this control. Traceability for both what a principal did inside Azure and who that principal was at the directory layer now exists. A regression -- any of the diagnosticSettings blocks removed, or either the Activity Log or Entra diagnostic setting dropped from layer-06-platform.yml -- would reopen it. The unverified Security Administrator prerequisite (see that step's comment) is worth a live-tenant check but does not itself reopen this control.
